description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! 
 
 As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. 
 
 At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. 
 
 Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! 
 
 
 Elanco Animal Health is seeking a highly motivated and innovative Research Scientist to join our Discovery Research team. This role is specifically focused on leveraging advanced Single B-cell sequencing platforms and Immune Library construction to identify high-quality therapeutic antibody candidates for animal health. The successful candidate will be a technical expert in capturing and isolating the natural immune repertoire of diverse species through comprehensive NGS workflows to drive the earliest stages of our biologics pipeline.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Single B-cell Discovery Campaigns: Lead and execute end-to-end single-B-cell antibody discovery workflows, including immune-cell processing, FACS-based isolation of antigen-specific B cells, single-cell sequencing, and high-throughput molecular rescue of paired V-region sequences.

 Immune Library Strategy: Design and construct high-diversity immune libraries from immunized animals. Implement robust NGS workflows for library characterization, monitoring diversity, and tracking selection dynamics across display platforms.

 Panning & Selection: Manage complex panning and selection strategies using phage or yeast display to isolate rare, high-affinity binders from diverse immune repertoires.

 Molecular Rescue & Cloning: Utilize high-throughput RT-PCR, nested PCR, and specialized cloning techniques to rescue heavy and light chain variable regions from single cells.

 NGS Data Integration: Work closely with bioinformatics pipelines to integrate large-scale NGS datasets, enabling the rapid identification of novel antibody lineages and analyzing repertoire convergence.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Represent the antibody discovery group in cross-functional project teams communicating discovery screening strategy

 Discovery Documentation: Maintain precise electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN) and present technical discovery data at internal research forums and stakeholder meetings.

 Evaluate and implement emerging antibody discovery technologies and workflows to improve throughput, repertoire diversity, functional screening, and discovery timelines.

 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Education :
 PhD in Immunology, Molecular Biology, or Biotechnology with 0-3 years of relevant industrial experience in biologics discovery.

 
 Technical Expertise: 
 Direct, hands-on experience with Single B-cell sequencing workflows and high-speed flow cytometry (FACS).

 Expertise in NGS library preparation and associated molecular biology techniques.

 Experience in Immune Library construction and display technologies

 Advanced proficiency in high-throughput PCR and molecular cloning

 
 Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!
 
 Elanco Benefits and Perks: 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package focusing on financial, physical, and mental well-being while encouraging our employees to pursue our purpose! Some highlights include:
 Multiple relocation packages 

 Two weeklong shutdowns (mid-summer and year-end) in the US (in addition to PTO) 

 8-week parental leave 

 9 Employee Resource Groups 

 Annual bonus offering 

 Flexible work arrangements 

 Up to 6% 401K matching
